task: 设置页文案重命名与鼠标选项移除；修复 GitHub Actions 检查失败

quality_requirements.evidence: 界面只保留可达设置；兼容键保留在运行时，但旧 UI、同步连接和不可达中键拖动行已移除；CI 观察器合同与证明文件纳入静态审计。
QtTest 覆盖精确文案、枚举数据、对象树、默认值、旧配置迁移、多语言布局、因果 Paint 观察和 120Hz 线程 CPU 预算；四级流水线汇总外部结果。
每个原子用例包含测试目的、前置条件、输入、步骤、预期和后置条件；报告保存命令、返回码、耗时、输出摘要和 SHA-256。

explicit_assumptions: 界面移除不等于删除持久化兼容键，因为 qvgraphicsview.cpp 仍读取两个键。
固定策略的有效范围是新安装与 migrateOldSettings() 完成后的启动；没有 UI 路径再写入旧策略。
GitHub Actions 的 Cocoa 系统测试在 macos-26 runner 上执行，非 macOS 本地环境只能完成静态阶段。
异步 refinement 的完成时刻不属于滚动 Paint 的验收输入；首个可见 Paint 才是面积断言输入，pending 状态只用于 teardown。
120Hz 交互预算定义为 Qt GUI 调用线程的 CPU 执行时间；CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID 不包含线程被调度器暂停或等待 WindowServer 的墙钟间隔。

research_trace.finding: The latest Checks run for commit 119f5fe failed in Run Unit Tests; the hosted log reports a 120Hz CPU-budget assertion with average below the budget but p99 above it.
research_trace.explicit_premise: A failed GitHub Actions run log is the direct observation of the failing CI predicate.
research_trace.deduction: The first branch of the diagnosis must inspect the measured quantity and its threshold, not change the rendering implementation.

research_trace.finding: The corresponding Build Fovelle run also fails in the complete CTest path at testVectorInteractionPaintCpuBudgetFor120Hz, while the average samples remain well below 8.333 ms and a pan p99 contains a large outlier.
research_trace.explicit_premise: Two independent workflow jobs observe the same performance-test failure boundary.
research_trace.deduction: The failure is reproducible at the test observer level and is not an artifact of only the acceptance-audit wrapper.

research_trace.finding: The repository builds with CMake and runs the Qt tests on macos-26 with Qt 6.11.2, Cocoa, and CTest.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The hosted runner and the local test source are part of the test's stated execution contract.
research_trace.deduction: A timing-sensitive wall-clock measurement is exposed to hosted-runner scheduling even when application work is unchanged.

research_trace.finding: The macos-26 arm64 image records a changing hosted image identity and macOS/Xcode toolchain details.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The runner is a shared hosted environment rather than a dedicated real-time CPU.
research_trace.deduction: Descheduling and WindowServer delays are admissible wall-clock noise and cannot be treated as application CPU work.

research_trace.finding: QElapsedTimer provides elapsed monotonic wall time; it does not identify how much CPU execution the calling thread received.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The failing code used QElapsedTimer around synchronous QWidget::repaint().
research_trace.deduction: The old p99 predicate measured W_i = C_i + D_i, so a scheduling delay D_i could fail the test without a renderer regression.

research_trace.finding: POSIX defines CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID as CPU execution time for the calling thread and distinguishes it from elapsed real time.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The interactive zoom/pan operation and synchronous repaint execute on the Qt GUI thread.
research_trace.deduction: The repaired sample c_i = T_thread_end - T_thread_start directly measures the CPU quantity named by the existing test.

research_trace.finding: Qt recommends condition-based waits and warns that fixed timing assumptions are fragile in asynchronous tests.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The repository already uses explicit bounded QTest conditions for GUI readiness and teardown.
research_trace.deduction: The performance test should retain bounded functional setup but must not use scheduler-sensitive wall-time p99 as a CPU-work assertion.

research_trace.finding: The SettingsAudit static contract requires an explicit !reports/solution_and_proof.md rule, which was absent from the current .gitignore.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The latest SettingsAudit failure is an independent source-contract failure, not a consequence of the CPU benchmark.
research_trace.deduction: The complete fix must add the explicit report-tracking rule and preserve the proof artifact as part of the CI acceptance interface.

research_trace.finding: The repaired probe logs measurement=thread_cpu and directly exercises EPS/SVG zoom and pan samples; the audit registers the same method as an atomic unit case.
research_trace.explicit_premise: A test is reproducible only when its input, clock, selector, bounds, and output marker are explicit.
research_trace.deduction: The fix is testable without modifying production rendering or hiding the p99/120-FPS requirement.

research_trace.finding: GitHub documents using failed run logs and recorded runner information to diagnose a workflow failure.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The report must distinguish confirmed hosted observations, local verification, and claims not yet remotely rerun.
research_trace.deduction: Reports record the two pre-fix run URLs, explicit premises, local four-stage evidence, and remote_reexecution=false until a push/rerun occurs.
